page.overview:
Who is Perona?

"Ghost Princess" Perona is a member of the Thriller Bark Pirates and the former commander of the Wild Zombies and Surprise Zombies, prior to Thriller Bark's collapse.

She was introduced as one of the Mysterious Four, the highest-ranking officers of Thriller Bark; however, she was sent to Kuraigaina Island by Bartholomew Kuma before the defeat of Gecko Moria's army. She resided in the island's castle for about two years, and during the timeskip she begrudgingly helped Roronoa Zoro during his training under Dracule Mihawk. She briefly helped the Straw Hat Pirates when they returned to Sabaody, stopping a battalion of Marines with her Horo-Horo ghosts.

Due to her actions, she can be considered a major antagonist in the Thriller Bark Saga and an ally of Roronoa Zoro and the Straw Hat Pirates during the timeskip and Return to Sabaody Arc.

Perona is a short young woman with big, round black eyes and asymmetrical eyelashes on the bottom of each of her eyelids that may represent eyeliner. She has long, waist-length, light pink hair that she keeps tied into two pigtails with black and white flower hairpins. She wears a red crown with a black cross on her head, as well as red lipstick and a thick layer of black eyeliner. Her white long-sleeved shirt with three different black heart shapes was short enough to expose her belly. She wears a red mini cape with a pink ribbon in front. Her black-and-white striped tights completely cover her legs, and she wears a mini-skirt and a red-and-gold belt with a heart belt buckle, as well as red buckled boots. She usually keeps her toes pointing inwards in a pigeon-toed manner and carried around a red parasol shaped like a cute version of a mini devil prior to her battle with Usopp.
